gameoverse_tutorial.move.title: Welcome to Gameoverse
gameoverse_tutorial.move.text.controller: Walk around with the left stick.
gameoverse_tutorial.verify.title: Verify to start playing
gameoverse_tutorial.verify.text: Type /discordverify and send the code to our Discord bot, or ask a verified player to /vouch you.
gameoverse_tutorial.guide.title: Open the Guide
gameoverse_tutorial.guide.text: Press %s. Everything this server changes is explained in it.
gameoverse_tutorial.guide.text.controlle: Hold Back. Everything this server changes is explained in it.
gameoverse_tutorial.logs.title: Get some wood
gameoverse_tutorial.logs.text: Hold %s on a tree trunk to collect 3 logs.
gameoverse_tutorial.logs.text.controller: Hold RT on a tree trunk to collect 3 logs.
gameoverse_tutorial.crafting_table.title: Craft a Crafting Table
gameoverse_tutorial.crafting_table.text: Press %s, turn logs into planks, then 4 planks into a Crafting Table.
Press Y, turn logs into planks, then 4 planks into a Crafting Table.
gameoverse_tutorial.wooden_pickaxe.title: Craft a Wooden Pickaxe
gameoverse_tutorial.wooden_pickaxe.text: Place the Crafting Table and use planks and sticks.
gameoverse_tutorial.stone_pickaxe.title: Upgrade to stone
gameoverse_tutorial.stone_pickaxe.text: Mine some stone and craft a Stone Pickaxe.
gameoverse_tutorial.coal.title: Find coal
gameoverse_tutorial.coal.text: Mine coal ore, or smelt logs into charcoal. You'll need it to smelt ore and, later, for a Campfire.
gameoverse_tutorial.campfire.title: Build a Campfire
gameoverse_tutorial.campfire.text: Sticks, coal and logs. It's your stove, your light and your way to heal.
gameoverse_tutorial.cook.title: Cook on the Campfire
gameoverse_tutorial.cook.text: Put raw meat on the lit Campfire with %s. Cooked food heals more than raw, and Furnaces don't cook food here.
gameoverse_tutorial.cook.text.controller: Put raw meat on the lit Campfire with LT. Cooked food heals more than raw, and Furnaces don't cook food here.
gameoverse_tutorial.copper.title: Find copper
gameoverse_tutorial.copper.text: Iron needs a Copper Pickaxe. Mine copper ore with your Stone Pickaxe.
gameoverse_tutorial.smelt_copper.title: Smelt the copper
gameoverse_tutorial.smelt_copper.text: Craft a Furnace from 8 Cobblestone and smelt 3 Copper Ingots.
gameoverse_tutorial.copper_pickaxe.title: Craft a Copper Pickaxe
gameoverse_tutorial.iron.title: Mine iron
gameoverse_tutorial.iron.text: Iron lies deeper than copper, often in caves: bring torches. Smelt about 14 Iron Ingots; your first iron tools take a small machine.
gameoverse_tutorial.press.title: Build a Mechanical Press
gameoverse_tutorial.press.text: Iron gear needs Iron Sheets. The Guide's Iron Forge page has each recipe.
gameoverse_tutorial.hand_crank.title: Craft a Hand Crank
gameoverse_tutorial.hand_crank.text: Planks and Andesite Alloy. It powers the Press by hand.
gameoverse_tutorial.iron_sheet.title: Press 4 Iron Sheets
gameoverse_tutorial.iron_sheet.text: Put the Crank on the Press, drop an Iron Ingot under it and turn the Crank with %s.
gameoverse_tutorial.iron_sheet.text.cont: Put the Crank on the Press, drop an Iron Ingot under it and turn the Crank with LT.
gameoverse_tutorial.iron_pickaxe.title: Craft an Iron Pickaxe
gameoverse_tutorial.oil.title: Get cooking oil
gameoverse_tutorial.oil.text: Craft a Kitchen Knife (copper works) and kill a pig with it for Oil and pork.
gameoverse_tutorial.wok.title: Craft a Wok and Kitchen Shovel
gameoverse_tutorial.wok.text: Both are made from iron ingots.
gameoverse_tutorial.wok_oil.title: Heat the Wok
gameoverse_tutorial.wok_oil.text: Place the Wok on a lit Campfire, then use Oil on it with %s.
gameoverse_tutorial.wok_oil.text.control: Place the Wok on a lit Campfire, then use Oil on it with LT.
gameoverse_tutorial.stir_fry.title: Make Sweet and Sour Pork
gameoverse_tutorial.stir_fry.text: Add raw pork and Sugar, stir with the Kitchen Shovel until it's done, then serve into a Bowl.
gameoverse_tutorial.shield.title: Eat your dish
gameoverse_tutorial.shield.text: It gives Satiated Shield: hits up to 32 hearts are blocked while you're above a fifth of your health.
gameoverse_tutorial.done.title: You're on your own now
gameoverse_tutorial.done.text: The Guide (%s) has the rest. Good luck out there!
gameoverse_tutorial.done.text.controller: The Guide (hold Back) has the rest. Good luck out there!
gameoverse_tutorial.starter_house.title: Your starter house
gameoverse_tutorial.starter_house.text: Use the House blueprint on the ground with %s, pick a style and press Build! for a quick home. Or keep it and build your own.
gameoverse_tutorial.starter_house.text.c: Use the House blueprint on the ground with LT, pick a style and press Build! for a quick home. Or keep it and build your own.
gameoverse_tutorial.felling.title: Fell whole trees
gameoverse_tutorial.felling.text: Hit a log with an axe and keep swinging: the whole tree comes down. Hold %s to cut one log.
gameoverse_tutorial.felling.text.control: Hit a log with an axe and keep swinging: the whole tree comes down. Sneak to cut one log.
gameoverse_tutorial.veins.title: Break whole ore veins
gameoverse_tutorial.veins.text: Keep hitting ore with a pickaxe and the whole vein breaks. Hold %s to mine one block.
gameoverse_tutorial.veins.text.controlle: Keep hitting ore with a pickaxe and the whole vein breaks. Sneak to mine one block.
gameoverse_tutorial.campfire_fuel.title: Keep the fire going
gameoverse_tutorial.campfire_fuel.text: A Campfire burns about 90 seconds and rain puts it out. Throw in logs or coal, or build under a roof.
gameoverse_tutorial.cozy.title: You're Cozy
gameoverse_tutorial.cozy.text: Standing near a lit Campfire slowly heals you.
gameoverse_tutorial.food_effects.title: Food effects
gameoverse_tutorial.food_effects.text: Every food gives a short effect, longer the more it's cooked. Hover over food to see it.
gameoverse_tutorial.f3.title: Where am I?
gameoverse_tutorial.f3.text: F3 hides your position. Carry a Compass for your coordinates and a Clock for the time.
gameoverse_tutorial.death.title: You keep your items
gameoverse_tutorial.death.text: Dying costs one heart instead, down to 3. Heart Crystals give hearts back.
gameoverse_tutorial.heart_crystal.title: A Heart Crystal!
gameoverse_tutorial.heart_crystal.text: Eat it with %s for one more heart, for good.
gameoverse_tutorial.heart_crystal.text.c: Eat it with LT for one more heart, for good.
gameoverse_tutorial.rumor.title: A Rumor
gameoverse_tutorial.rumor.text: Use it with %s for a hint toward a landmark you haven't found.
gameoverse_tutorial.rumor.text.controlle: Use it with LT for a hint toward a landmark you haven't found.
gameoverse_tutorial.keys.title: A key
gameoverse_tutorial.keys.text: It opens a Locked Chest of its tier or lower. Each one holds extra loot.
gameoverse_tutorial.material_traits.text: Copper and gold gear have bonuses of their own. The tooltip lists them.
gameoverse_tutorial.command.off: Tutorial hints are off. /tutorial on brings them back.
gameoverse_tutorial.forage.title: Find something to eat
gameoverse_tutorial.forage.text: There's no hunger bar: food heals you, and you don't heal on your own. Berries, fruit and wild vegetables are fine raw. Hold %s to eat.
gameoverse_tutorial.forage.text.controll: There's no hunger bar: food heals you, and you don't heal on your own. Berries, fruit and wild vegetables are fine raw. Hold LT to eat.
gameoverse_tutorial.flint_and_steel.text: Flint (gravel always drops it when dug with a shovel) and your last Iron Sheet. Campfires here start unlit, and this lights them.
gameoverse_tutorial.light_campfire.title: Light it
gameoverse_tutorial.light_campfire.text: Place the Campfire and use Flint and Steel on it with %s.
Place the Campfire and use Flint and Steel on it with LT.
gameoverse_tutorial.bed.title: Make a safe bed
gameoverse_tutorial.bed.text: Craft a Bed from wool and planks. You can only sleep where monsters can't reach it: build walls around it and light the area.
gameoverse_tutorial.sleep.title: Night is falling
gameoverse_tutorial.sleep.text: Sleep in your Bed to skip it. If monsters can reach it, a trail of flames shows their way in: close that gap.
gameoverse_tutorial.gear.title: Gear up
gameoverse_tutorial.gear.text: Craft a copper weapon (a sword, axe or spear) and some Copper armor, and put the armor on. Iron sits deeper, where caves hold more monsters.
